name: Views Send
description: Provides a way to send email messages from a list created with Views.

suggests.drupal/rules: React to messages being sent or spooled.

project_description:
Views Send enables you to execute personalized mass mailing from a View. 

 Each row in the View generates one e-mail. The fields in the View can be used in the subject and mail body - through tokens - enabling easy personalized e-mails. The recipients (mail address and name) are obviously also take from the view.

 To get started, read setup and usage for the Drupal 7 or Drupal 8 and later versions of the module.

 For Drupal 6, read the documentation coming with the module.
